title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 253 ]

blocks.text: A farmer needs to be very careful about changing the food of his cows.

If the farmer makes a sudden change in food for cow, the cow may first lose weight. In addition, the cow that suddenly eats lots of a new food may give less milk. For these reasons, the farmer changes the cow's food slowly so that the cow can adapt to the new food.

readingSentences.english: A farmer needs to be very careful about changing the food of his cows.
readingSentences.korean: 농부는 자신의 소의 먹이를 바꿀 때 매우 주의할 필요가 있다.

readingSentences.english: If the farmer makes a sudden change in food for cow, the cow may first lose weight.
readingSentences.korean: 만약 농부가 젖소의 먹이를 갑자기 바꾸면, 먼저 젖소의 체중이 감소할 것이다.

readingSentences.english: In addition, the cow that suddenly eats lots of a new food may give less milk.
readingSentences.korean: 또한, 갑자기 새로운 먹이를 많이 먹으면 소의 우유량이 줄어들 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: For these reasons, the farmer changes the cow's food slowly so that the cow can adapt to the new food.
readingSentences.korean: 이런 까닭에, 젖소가 새로운 먹이에 적응할 수 있도록 농부는 젖소의 먹이를 천천히 바꾼다.
